speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
text: asked the Minister for Health having regard to the prevalence of vaping as a substitute for smoking and the potential for vaping and smoking activities to happen together, whether there is scope to consider synergising the enforcement capabilities of the Health Science Authority with the National Environment Agency to present a common front against vapers and those who are in breach of the prevailing regulations.

speaker: Mr Murali Pillai (Bukit Batok)
text: And really, we want to stem the tide, so to speak.
